q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a paper straw?
title: Paper straw carbon per straw
short: Weigh one straw, multiply the paper weight by the paper supplier's factor, add the adhesive, and add the winding and cutting electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 divided by straws made. Compare with plastic straws on the same basis, per straw, including disposal.
audience: Paper straw makers, cafes and beverage brands

p: Compare like for like. Use weights and supplier factors for both, and include disposal.
Used paper straws may be food-soiled. Say how they are disposed of when you compare.

example.title: Worked example: making energy per straw (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Add paper (about 1 g per straw, check yours) and adhesive from supplier data
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; weigh your straws and use the paper supplier's factor.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
